profile.name: Suman Khadka
profile.title: Full Stack Software Developer
profile.tagline: Full stack developer and IT systems specialist building enterprise software with .NET, React and the cloud.
profile.about: I'm a full stack software developer and IT systems specialist at Eckinger Construction Company, where I build and maintain the internal platform behind project management, reporting and operational workflows. I studied Computer Science with a minor in Statistics at the University of Akron, and I've shipped work across .NET, Next.js, React, Python and cloud tooling, from geotechnical data portals to coding-assessment platforms.

items.title: Full Stack Software Developer and IT Systems Specialist
bullets: Design and maintain backend services for the internal software platform using .NET Framework and DevExpress controls, building dynamic enterprise UI components for project management, data reporting and operational workflows.
Provide ongoing IT support and system administration for internal users, including troubleshooting hardware and software issues and optimizing workflow tools.
Collaborate with end users to gather requirements, refine feature specifications and deploy updates to internal software with minimal disruption.
Improve system stability and performance through code optimization, logging standards and environment configuration management.

items.title: Computer Science Intern (volunteer)
bullets: Contributed to website development and worked on the Shopify platform to create and customize product pages for nonprofit digital initiatives.

items.title: Software Application Developer
bullets: Completed structured training in enterprise application development, software development lifecycle processes and client-focused technology solutions.

items.title: Software Developer Co-op
bullets: Developed and debugged full-stack features for PDI's cloud data management portal, with a strong emphasis on intuitive and accessible front-end components using Next.js, Tailwind CSS and custom React hooks.
Constructed backend API endpoints in C# with .NET, ensuring scalable and secure data exchange for cloud-based geotechnical analysis.
Reduced production bugs by 25 percent through automated testing with Jest and Cypress; consistently implemented unit testing and code reviews to maintain high code quality.

items.title: Web Content Coordinator
items.org: EX[L] Center for Community Engaged Learning
bullets: Automated data categorization by developing a Python script to analyze and process complex datasets, boosting data processing efficiency by 40 percent.
Redesigned and updated accessible web pages using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, leading to a 20 percent increase in user engagement.

items.title: TravelMate
items.summary: Intelligent travel matching platform (Honors Research Project).
bullets: Implemented a real-time bidding system with complex database querying and a PostgreSQL API layer for dynamic user interactions and transaction processing.
Developed a web platform connecting travelers with local guides through a personalized trip posting system, using a Next.js frontend and a Supabase backend with PostgreSQL.

items.title: ZippyCode
bullets: Built a web-based coding assessment platform allowing users to write and test code directly in the browser, using React for the front end and Java Spring Boot for the back end.
Integrated the OpenAI API to automate coding question generation, dynamically enhancing learning content for users.

items.title: Statistical Analysis of Global Earthquake Patterns
bullets: Conducted a comprehensive statistical analysis of 782 global earthquakes (2001-2023) using advanced data management and visualization techniques in R.
Developed predictive insights on earthquake-tsunami relationships, identifying unidirectional causality patterns through statistical hypothesis testing.

items.title: Neural Network Using Backpropagation
bullets: Designed and implemented a feedforward neural network from first principles in Python, coding the backpropagation algorithm without high-level ML libraries.
